claims.text: The project controls a Minecraft Java 1.16.5 player through Mineflayer, using a separate model for planning and Jev for player actions.

evidence.quote: This project uses GPT-6 Astra or GPT-5.6 Sol to plan and JEV to select player actions in Minecraft Java 1.16.5. It uses the official vanilla server and Mineflayer. A read-only Java sensor can report the exact dragon head position. It does not change game rules or entity state. Each selected action is sent to the game through the normal player protocol.

claims.text: Astra or Sol sets objectives and waypoints; Jev chooses an available action from structured game observations, while Mineflayer executes movement and protocol interactions.

evidence.quote:
## Model roles

The planner sets the current objective, item targets, and a travel waypoint. JEV selects one available action from current game observations. Actions include travel, mining one block, collecting a drop, crafting, opening a chest, eating, sleeping, and combat interactions. Mineflayer handles the movement path and game protocol. This is structured-state control, not control from screenshots or individual key presses. The models can see blocks in loaded chunks. Known seed coordinates are supplied.

Model IDs:

- `openai/gpt-6-astra` (default) or `openai/gpt-5.6-sol` (`PLANNER_MODEL`), through `/api/v1/chat/completions`
- `typesafe/jev-1.13`, through `/api/alpha/decisions`

claims.text: Configure the model relay and local runtime paths, install dependencies, start the vanilla server, and launch the documented nether-agent workflow.

evidence.quote:
Model calls obtain the OpenRouter key from Google Secret Manager and keep it in process memory. The current scripts refer to the original deployment's project and secret name; these names are not credentials. Configure those references for your own project in `model-relay.mjs` and `models.mjs`. For the relay, authenticate with Google application default credentials, grant access to the secret, and set `MODEL_RELAY=http://127.0.0.1:3099` when starting the agent. Do not place keys in source files or run logs.

The native renderer and launch scripts were developed on macOS. Runtime paths and local server settings must be configured for another machine. Historical review notes describe earlier versions; use the current code and the result above for the latest behavior.

## Start a run

Install dependencies with `npm install`. Start `server/server.jar` from the `server` directory with a compatible Java runtime. The installed Minecraft Java runtime works for this server.

Use `./start-server.sh` to start the main server with its read-only sensor. For a fresh recording, first choose an unused world name in `server/server.properties`. Use a new log directory with the same name. Start the agent from this directory:

```sh
node optimization/nether/freeze-run.mjs NEW_RUN
PLANNER_MODEL=openai/gpt-6-astra RUN_ID=NEW_RUN \
NATIVE_VIEW=1 WAIT_NATIVE=1 NATIVE_RECORD=1 \
DRAGON_SENSOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3093 node nether-agent.mjs
```

When the local mirror is listening on port 25578, start `python3 native-client/launch.py`. The agent waits for the hidden client and recorder before the first action. The native client uses an isolated game directory. It does not change the user's Minecraft settings. The recorder stops after the exit portal event. To stop a test at an action boundary, create `runs/NEW_RUN/stop`. Wait for `full-playthrough.mp4.finished.json` before closing the native client.

The native client dependencies are installed with `python3 native-client/install.py`; build the display and capture adapter with `./native-client/build.sh`. The supplied launch script uses its local Java 17 runtime. Model access requires available OpenRouter credit.

claims.text: The route uses a known seed and supplied coordinates rather than screenshot control. Recordings and generated run evidence remain local and are excluded from Git.

evidence.quote: **Recordings and generated evidence remain local and are excluded from Git.** The local video is `runs/nether-final-08/full-playthrough-banner.mp4`. Its verification, timing comparison, and action log are in the same run directory. This repository contains the code, tests, build scripts, and route data. It does not include Minecraft binaries, downloaded runtimes, saved worlds, or credentials.

The selected seed has a village, three supply chests with 21 obsidian, and a naturally active End portal. The route uses the Nether as a travel shortcut and requires entry and exit before combat. It does not need blaze rods. This is a useful speedrun seed, not proof of the easiest possible seed. The route was surveyed in a separate test world. Final-run placements and movement use normal player interactions.

## Model roles

The planner sets the current objective, item targets, and a travel waypoint. JEV selects one available action from current game observations. Actions include travel, mining one block, collecting a drop, crafting, opening a chest, eating, sleeping, and combat interactions. Mineflayer handles the movement path and game protocol. This is structured-state control, not control from screenshots or individual key presses. The models can see blocks in loaded chunks. Known seed coordinates are supplied.

The final route is fixed in `optimization/nether/config.json`. Astra receives game state and route observations; JEV selects bounded actions. Mineflayer performs pathfinding and timed block interactions. This is not screenshot-only or individual-key control. The native view mirrors the bot state. Its camera uses small turns, and its inventory screens show the current item and cursor state. The final run used no live operator guidance or repairs.

vi.title: minecraft-agent — Astra lập kế hoạch, Jev hành động trong Minecraft
vi.h1: minecraft-agent — Astra lập kế hoạch, Jev hành động trong Minecraft
vi.description: minecraft-agent: Astra hoặc Sol lập kế hoạch Minecraft Java; Jev chọn hành động từ trạng thái game rồi Mineflayer thực hiện.
vi.summary: Dự án điều khiển người chơi Minecraft Java 1.16.5 qua Mineflayer, dùng mô hình riêng để lập kế hoạch và Jev để chọn hành động. Cấu hình bộ chuyển tiếp mô hình và đường dẫn cục bộ, cài phụ thuộc, khởi động máy chủ vanilla rồi chạy quy trình nether-agent trong tài liệu.

sections.heading: Công dụng
sections.text: Dự án điều khiển người chơi Minecraft Java 1.16.5 qua Mineflayer, dùng mô hình riêng để lập kế hoạch và Jev để chọn hành động.

sections.heading: Vai trò của Jev
sections.text: Astra hoặc Sol đặt mục tiêu và điểm đến; Jev chọn hành động khả dụng từ quan sát có cấu trúc, còn Mineflayer thực hiện di chuyển và tương tác giao thức.

sections.heading: Cách bắt đầu
sections.text: Cấu hình bộ chuyển tiếp mô hình và đường dẫn cục bộ, cài phụ thuộc, khởi động máy chủ vanilla rồi chạy quy trình nether-agent trong tài liệu.

sections.heading: Phạm vi và giới hạn
sections.text: Lộ trình dùng seed đã biết và tọa độ được cung cấp, không điều khiển qua ảnh chụp màn hình. Video và bằng chứng chạy được giữ cục bộ, không đưa vào Git.

tr.title: minecraft-agent — Minecraft’ta Astra planlar, Jev hareketi seçer
tr.h1: minecraft-agent — Minecraft’ta Astra planlar, Jev hareketi seçer
tr.description: minecraft-agent: Minecraft Java’da Astra veya Sol planlar, Jev oyun durumundan sınırlı eylemler seçer ve Mineflayer yürütür.
tr.summary: Proje, Minecraft Java 1.16.5 oyuncusunu Mineflayer ile yönetir; ayrı model planlama yaparken Jev oyuncu eylemlerini seçer. Model aktarımını ve yerel çalışma yollarını yapılandırın, bağımlılıkları kurun, vanilla sunucuyu başlatıp belgelenen nether-agent akışını çalıştırın.

sections.heading: Ne işe yarar
sections.text: Proje, Minecraft Java 1.16.5 oyuncusunu Mineflayer ile yönetir; ayrı model planlama yaparken Jev oyuncu eylemlerini seçer.

sections.heading: Jev’in rolü
sections.text: Astra veya Sol hedefleri ve yol noktalarını belirler; Jev yapılandırılmış gözlemlerden uygun eylemi seçer, Mineflayer hareketi ve protokol etkileşimlerini yürütür.

sections.heading: Başlangıç
sections.text: Model aktarımını ve yerel çalışma yollarını yapılandırın, bağımlılıkları kurun, vanilla sunucuyu başlatıp belgelenen nether-agent akışını çalıştırın.

sections.heading: Kapsam ve sınırlar
sections.text: Rota, ekran görüntüsü kontrolü yerine bilinen seed ve verilen koordinatları kullanır. Kayıtlar ve oluşturulan çalışma kanıtları yerelde tutulur, Git’e dahil edilmez.

it.title: minecraft-agent — Astra pianifica e Jev agisce in Minecraft
it.h1: minecraft-agent — Astra pianifica e Jev agisce in Minecraft
it.description: minecraft-agent: Astra o Sol pianifica in Minecraft Java; Jev sceglie azioni circoscritte dallo stato e Mineflayer le esegue.
it.summary: Il progetto controlla un giocatore di Minecraft Java 1.16.5 tramite Mineflayer, separando il modello di pianificazione dalla scelta delle azioni con Jev. Configura il relay dei modelli e i percorsi locali, installa le dipendenze, avvia il server vanilla e segui il flusso nether-agent documentato.

sections.heading: A cosa serve
sections.text: Il progetto controlla un giocatore di Minecraft Java 1.16.5 tramite Mineflayer, separando il modello di pianificazione dalla scelta delle azioni con Jev.

sections.heading: Ruolo di Jev
sections.text: Astra o Sol imposta obiettivi e punti di passaggio; Jev sceglie un’azione disponibile dalle osservazioni strutturate e Mineflayer esegue movimenti e interazioni.

sections.heading: Come iniziare
sections.text: Configura il relay dei modelli e i percorsi locali, installa le dipendenze, avvia il server vanilla e segui il flusso nether-agent documentato.

sections.heading: Ambito e limiti
sections.text: Il percorso usa un seed noto e coordinate fornite, senza controllo tramite screenshot. Registrazioni e prove generate restano locali e sono escluse da Git.
